questions.question: How long does delivery to the contiguous US take?
questions.answer: Orders to the contiguous US (the lower 48 states) are delivered within 2-3 business days of leaving the warehouse.

questions.question: How much is shipping?
questions.answer: Shipping within the contiguous US is free on orders over $50; otherwise it costs $4.95. Shipping to Alaska costs $9.95 and to Hawaii, $14.95.

questions.question: Do you ship to Alaska and Hawaii?
questions.answer: Yes. Deliveries to Alaska take 3-5 business days and to Hawaii, 5-7 business days.

questions.question: Do you ship outside the 50 states?
questions.answer: We ship to Canada and Puerto Rico. For other countries, write to us and we'll give you a quote.

questions.question: How do I track my order?
questions.answer: When your order leaves the warehouse we send you an email with the tracking number and a link to the carrier's website.

questions.question: Can I pick up my order at the store?
questions.answer: Yes. Choose “In-store pickup” at checkout; we'll let you know when it's ready, usually within 24 hours, and it's free of charge.

questions.question: How long do I have to return a product?
questions.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return an unused product in its original packaging.

questions.question: How do I make a return?
questions.answer: Go to “My Orders”, choose the product and click “Return”. We'll pick it up free of charge at the address you give us.

questions.question: When do I get my money back for a return?
questions.answer: We refund the amount within 14 days at most of receiving the product, using the same payment method you used.

questions.question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
questions.answer: Yes. Request a return and place a new order in the right size; the second shipment is free.

questions.question: Can sale items be returned?
questions.answer: Yes, discounted items have the same return conditions as everything else.

questions.question: What warranty do the products have?
questions.answer: All products have a 2-year warranty, including e-bike batteries.

questions.question: What do I do if a product arrives broken or defective?
questions.answer: Write to us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo of the damage; we'll replace it at no cost.

questions.question: Does the warranty cover wear and tear?
questions.answer: It doesn't cover normal wear of parts such as tires, brake pads, chains or cables, nor damage caused by crashes or misuse.

questions.question: Do you do repairs and tune-ups?
questions.answer: Yes, our Portland repair shop does tune-ups from $35 and repairs with an estimate up front. The first tune-up for bikes bought here is free.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept card, PayPal, Apple Pay and bank transfer.

questions.question: Can I pay in installments?
questions.answer: Yes, on purchases over $300 you can pay over 3, 6 or 12 months with interest-free financing.

questions.question: How do I get the invoice for my purchase?
questions.answer: You can download the invoice from “My Orders”. If you need it made out to a company, say so at checkout or write to us.

questions.question: Do you have gift cards?
questions.answer: Yes, for $25, $50 and $100. They are sent by email and are valid for one year.

questions.question: How do I use a discount coupon?
questions.answer: Enter the code in the “Coupon” field before paying. Only one coupon can be used per order.

questions.question: What size bike do I need?
questions.answer: It depends on your height and the type of bike. Every product page has a size chart; if in doubt, measure your inseam and write to us.

questions.question: Do the bikes come assembled?
questions.answer: They arrive 90% assembled: you only need to attach the handlebars and the pedals. We include the tools and a video with the instructions.

questions.question: What range do the e-bikes have?
questions.answer: Between 40 and 75 miles depending on the model, the assist level, the weight and the terrain.

questions.question: How long does the battery take to charge?
questions.answer: A full charge takes between 4 and 6 hours with the included charger.

questions.question: Do you sell bikes for children?
questions.answer: Yes, from balance bikes without pedals for 2-year-olds up to 24-inch models for children aged 8 to 11.

questions.question: When will an out-of-stock product be available again?
questions.answer: On the product page you can click “Notify me” and we'll write to you as soon as it's back in stock.

questions.question: What are the store's opening hours?
questions.answer: The Portland store is open Monday to Friday from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. and on Saturdays from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.

questions.question: How can I contact you?
questions.answer: By phone at (503) 555-0100, Monday to Friday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., or by email at hello@northcycles.com.

questions.question: Can I try a bike before buying it?
questions.answer: Yes, at the Portland store you can try any display model; for e-bikes, it's best to book an appointment.

questions.question: Do you rent bikes?
questions.answer: Yes, we rent city bikes and e-bikes by the day from $20, with helmet and lock included.
